attributes.board_name: Colorado State Board of Veterinary Medicine (Division of Professions and Occupations)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Any RACE-approved course is accepted automatically; other courses must meet Board criteria (biomedical or nonbiomedical subject, live or online, 45-60 min = 1 h)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed 12 months or less before first expiration: no CE for first renewal; more than 12 but less than 24 months: 16 hours.
rules.alternatives: Military renewal exemption; Substance Use Prevention Training exemption for national board certification with equivalent training or attestation of not prescribing opioids.
rules.audit_note: Compliance audits after each license period; keep records 4 years.

topics.who: All veterinarians (Substance Use Prevention Training), unless exempt

rules.notes: Up to 16 h nonbiomedical. From the 2026-2028 period (after Nov 1, 2026) 2 h on supervision and delegation are also required (no topic code). Current licenses expire 10/31/2026, renewable through 12/31/2026.
